name: Paul McCartney
description: Paul McCartney in the 1965 Beatles cartoon style, with expressive eyes and a blue suit.
character_notes: Paul McCartney 1965 Beatles cartoon. Softer compact rounded face, SHORT small nose, large expressive eyes, arched eyebrows, black mop hair. Blue suit jacket and matching long blue trousers, blue collared shirt and narrow navy tie, black pointed shoes. Preserve original mature slender cartoon body proportions. No bass or new props. Flat cel-cartoon colors and crisp black outlines, exact source identity. Head pitch/yaw for looks with anchored frontal torso and feet.
